name: Zulip
summary: Any tools including AI may be used to understand the code and write it, but contributors must understand, test and be able to explain every change. AI-generated messages are not allowed in the development community, apart from help with spelling, grammar or translation, and LLMs should not be pointed at the code to find problems.

evidence.quote: You can use any tools that help you understand the Zulip codebase and write good code, including AI tools.
Do not submit an AI-generated PR you haven't personally understood and tested
Don't point an LLM at the code and ask it to find problems or things to work on.
we want to read your own genuine expression of your thoughts.
It's fine to use whatever tools you like for help with spelling, grammar, or translation.
